==Large Group Options==
I think we're aiming for 30 people.

We need a large meeting space and an oceanfront view.

Some of us could camp nearby.

Options:
*[http://www.oregonbeachvacations.com/rental/house.html?ID=289&User=ORB9044&Avail=&Stay= End of the Continent] sleeps 22 at Gleneden Beach. My favorite in terms of how nice the house is.
*[http://www.oregonbeachvacations.com/rental/house.html?ID=287&User=ORB9044&Avail=&Stay= Whale Watcher] sleeps 20 in Lincoln City. Could work.
*[http://www.oregonbeachvacations.com/rental/house.html?ID=134&User=ORB9044&Avail=&Stay= Captain John's Beach House] sleeps 18 at Lincoln City.
*[http://www.oregonbeachvacations.com/rental/house.html?ID=140&User=ORB9044&Avail=&Stay= Shear Water] sleeps 16 at Depoe Bay
*[http://www.oregonbeachvacations.com/rental/house.html?ID=126&User=ORB9044&Avail=&Stay= Penthouse Escape] sleeps 17 in Lincoln City. "Ocean view" but 2 blocks to beach.
